mechanism: Case base of error-to-operator correction cases retrieved to guide iterative code refinement
evidence_scope: TextBFGS maintains a dynamic Case Base of historical "Error-to-Operator" correction trajectories to approximate the semantic curvature (inverse Hessian matrix) of the task.
evidence_role: we intro- duce TextBFGS, a Case-Based Reasoning (CBR) framework inspired by the Quasi-Newton optimization method.
